Question
========
How is inequality linked to sustainability, according to Chancel (2022)?

Answerlist
----------
* The global top 10% of emitters cause almost half of all greenhouse gas emissions
* Emissions are distributed roughly equally across income groups
* The poorest half of the world population causes most emissions
* There is no measurable link between income and emissions

Solution
========
Chancel shows that the global top 10% of emitters are responsible for almost half of emissions, while the bottom half causes about a tenth.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
